title: Remove automatic multi-action bullet splitting feature

requirements.summary: Remove all UI elements related to automatic paragraph-to-multiple-bullet conversion based on internal phrase detection
acceptanceCriteria: No UI controls visible for multi-action splitting feature
User cannot enable or disable multi-action splitting from the interface

file_operations.description: Remove any UI controls (checkboxes, toggle switches, labels, or explanatory text) that reference automatic multi-action splitting, paragraph-to-multiple-bullet conversion, or semantic phrase detection. Preserve all other UI elements including Clean Notes button, Reset Output button, TXT Download button, File Name option, and controls for Basic Bullet Formatting, Definition Style Format, and Headings Auto Detect features.

requirements.summary: Disable and remove the background logic that attempts to break a single sentence into multiple bullets without punctuation
acceptanceCriteria: Each grammatically complete sentence is converted into exactly one bullet point
No automatic splitting of sentences based on action phrase detection
Long sentences remain as single bullets regardless of word count or detected action phrases

file_operations.description: Remove the multi-pass semantic splitting system that detects action phrases in long sentences and splits them into multiple bullets. Ensure that each grammatically complete sentence (ending with punctuation like period, question mark, exclamation mark) is converted into exactly one bullet point. Remove any logic that attempts to break sentences based on internal phrase detection, action word identification, or word count thresholds. Preserve the core sentence-to-bullet conversion that respects natural punctuation boundaries.

requirements.summary: Retain and ensure continued functionality of Basic Bullet Formatting, Definition Style Format, and Headings Auto Detect features
acceptanceCriteria: Basic bullet formatting continues to work

file_operations.description: Verify and preserve the existing logic for Basic Bullet Formatting (converting sentences to bullet points with dash style), Definition Style Format (handling colon-based definitions), and Headings Auto Detect (identifying and formatting headings based on capitalization patterns or other markers). Ensure these features continue to work correctly after removing the multi-action splitting logic.

Verify and preserve the UI controls and functionality for Basic Bullet Formatting, Definition Style Format, and Headings Auto Detect features. Ensure these features remain accessible and functional to users after removing multi-action splitting UI elements.

requirements.summary: Preserve all existing UI controls including Clean Notes button, Reset Output button, TXT Download button, File Name option, and overall UI layout
acceptanceCriteria: All existing buttons remain functional and unchanged
UI layout stays identical to current design
File name customization continues to work

file_operations.description: Verify that Clean Notes button, Reset Output button, TXT Download button, File Name input field, and overall page layout remain untouched and fully functional. Ensure no modifications are made to button handlers, styling, or layout structure except for the removal of multi-action splitting UI elements as specified in REQ-1.
Verify that the TXT download functionality and file naming logic (both auto-generated and custom) remain unchanged and continue to work correctly with the updated formatting logic.
